        otherwise:
            if length of stack is 0:
                give back no
            let top_index be length of stack
            let opening be item top_index of stack
            if character is ")":
                if opening is not "(":
                    give back no
            otherwise if character is "]":
                if opening is not "[":
                    give back no
            otherwise:
                if opening is not "{{":
                    give back no
            remove item top_index of stack
    give back length of stack is 0

    let maybe_count be ask for a number ""
    if maybe_count is not nothing:
        let count be value of maybe_count
        repeat count times:
            let line be ask ""
            if (brackets_are_valid with line):
                say "valid"
            otherwise:
                say "invalid"

to main:
    let count_answer be ask for a number ""
    if count_answer is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_answer
        let output_parts be an empty list of text
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let first_answer be ask for a number ""
            if first_answer is nothing:
                say ""
            otherwise:
                let run_start be value of first_answer
                let run_end be run_start

                repeat (count - 1) times:
                    let next_answer be ask for a number ""
                    if next_answer is nothing:
                        skip
                    otherwise:
                        let next_number be value of next_answer
                        if next_number is run_end + 1:
                            set run_end to next_number
                        otherwise:
                            let run_length be run_end - run_start + 1
                            if run_length is at least 3:
                                add "{run_start}-{run_end}" to output_parts
                            otherwise:
                                add "{run_start}" to output_parts
                                if run_length is 2:
                                    add "{run_end}" to output_parts
                            set run_start to next_number
                            set run_end to next_number

                let final_run_length be run_end - run_start + 1
                if final_run_length is at least 3:
                    add "{run_start}-{run_end}" to output_parts
                otherwise:
                    add "{run_start}" to output_parts
                    if final_run_length is 2:
                        add "{run_end}" to output_parts
                let output_line be output_parts joined with ","
                say output_line

    set count_answer to ask for a number ""
    if count_answer is nothing:
        print ""
        stop
    set count to value of count_answer
    set output_parts to an empty list of text
    if count is 0:
        print ""
        stop

    set first_answer to ask for a number ""
    if first_answer is nothing:
        print ""
        stop
    set run_start to value of first_answer
    set run_end to run_start

    repeat count - 1 times:
        set next_answer to ask for a number ""
        if next_answer is nothing:
            stop
        set next_number to value of next_answer
        if next_number is run_end + 1:
            set run_end to next_number
        otherwise:
            set run_length to run_end - run_start + 1
            if run_length is at least 3:
                add "{run_start}-{run_end}" to output_parts
            otherwise:
                add "{run_start}" to output_parts
                if run_length is 2:
                    add "{run_end}" to output_parts
            set run_start to next_number
            set run_end to next_number

    set run_length to run_end - run_start + 1
    if run_length is at least 3:
        add "{run_start}-{run_end}" to output_parts
    otherwise:
        add "{run_start}" to output_parts
        if run_length is 2:
            add "{run_end}" to output_parts
    set output_line to output_parts joined with ","
    print output_line

to main:
    let count_maybe be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_maybe
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let output_parts be an empty list of text
        let first_maybe be ask for a number ""
        let run_start be value of first_maybe
        let run_end be run_start
        let run_length be 1

        let remaining be count - 1
        repeat remaining times:
            let next_maybe be ask for a number ""
            let next_number be value of next_maybe
            if next_number is run_end + 1:
                set run_end to next_number
                set run_length to run_length + 1
            otherwise:
                if run_length is at least 3:
                    add "{run_start}-{run_end}" to output_parts
                otherwise:
                    add "{run_start}" to output_parts
                    if run_length is 2:
                        add "{run_end}" to output_parts
                set run_start to next_number
                set run_end to next_number
                set run_length to 1

        if run_length is at least 3:
            add "{run_start}-{run_end}" to output_parts
        otherwise:
            add "{run_start}" to output_parts
            if run_length is 2:
                add "{run_end}" to output_parts
        let output be output_parts joined with ","
        say output

results.source_text:
to main:
    let item_totals be a map from text to number
    let item_names be an empty list of text
    let count_maybe be ask for a number ""
    let count be 0
    if count_maybe is not nothing:
        set count to value of count_maybe
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let item_name be item 1 of parts
        let quantity_text be item 2 of parts
        let quantity_maybe be number from quantity_text
        if quantity_maybe is not nothing:
            let quantity be value of quantity_maybe
            if item_totals contains item_name:
                let old_total be item item_name of item_totals
                let new_total be old_total + quantity
                set item item_name of item_totals to new_total
            otherwise:
                set item item_name of item_totals to quantity
                add item_name to item_names
    let name_count be length of item_names
    for each left_index from 1 to name_count:
        let right_index be left_index + 1
        while right_index is at most name_count:
            let left_name be item left_index of item_names
            let right_name be item right_index of item_names
            if left_name is more than right_name:
                set item left_index of item_names to right_name
                set item right_index of item_names to left_name
            set right_index to right_index + 1
    for each index from 1 to name_count:
        let item_name be item index of item_names
        let total be item item_name of item_totals
        say "{item_name} {total}"

to main:
    let count_maybe be ask for a number ""
    if count_maybe is nothing:
        give back
    let count be value of count_maybe
    let totals be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let item_name be item 1 of parts
        let quantity_text be item 2 of parts
        let quantity_maybe be number from quantity_text
        if quantity_maybe is not nothing:
            let quantity be value of quantity_maybe
            if totals contains item_name:
                let old_total be item item_name of totals
                set item item_name of totals to old_total + quantity
            otherwise:
                set item item_name of totals to quantity
    let item_names be keys of totals
    while length of item_names is more than 0:
        let smallest_index be 1
        let smallest_name be item 1 of item_names
        for each index from 1 to length of item_names:
            let candidate_name be item index of item_names
            if candidate_name is less than smallest_name:
                set smallest_index to index
                set smallest_name to candidate_name
        let item_name be smallest_name
        let total be item item_name of totals
        say "{item_name} {total}"
        remove item smallest_index of item_names
